reason.description: Reason for promotion: the evidence you checked (appended to content as evidence trail). Promoting an already-CONFIRMED entry is an explicit re-verification: when its stored basis no longer matches the cited files at HEAD, the basis is re-stamped at HEAD and the result reports rebased: true.
